summary: N6 same CFG, different semantics: ascending/descending and min-heap/max-heap twins built from one template, plus three token-bucket refills that differ only in two constants. v2 flips exactly one comparison operator in one twin; v3 changes exactly one constant in one refill. Control flow graphs stay identical, only a condition code or an immediate changes.

pairs.intent: Exactly one comparison operator flips, in lbound_desc (> becomes >=). The function keeps its control flow graph, block count, size and almost every instruction; a matcher that scores structure sees a perfect match. Meanwhile its twin lbound_asc and the other twin pairs have the same shape and must not be swapped with it.

truth.label: changed
truth.notes: a[mid] > key became a[mid] >= key: the lower-bound search of a descending array turns into an upper-bound search and differs only for keys equal to an element. CFG and block count are unchanged; one condition code differs
